name: delivery-harness
description: One product-to-PR workflow with approved specifications, isolated agents, evidence-bound verification and safe Git delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Product context, precise specs, verified delivery.
interface.longDescription: A self-contained coordinator for product memory, risk-proportional specifications, isolated task execution, independent review and a fresh-main worktree-to-PR lifecycle. Human approval remains explicit for material decisions, side effects and merging.
defaultPrompt: Use $delivery to take this change from intent to a verified PR.
Use $delivery to resume an existing run and recheck its evidence.
